title: Nocturne Review: Still the Roleplay Benchmark
description: Three weeks with Nocturne: memory that holds across sessions, a huge scenario library, and a privacy policy that needs work.
author: Mara Quill

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: This is a sample review showing the review template. Every real review says whether it is based on hands-on testing or research.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body: Nocturne is a browser-based AI sex chat platform built around long-form roleplay, with a library of community-written scenarios and a character builder.

sections.heading: Memory and roleplay
sections.body: Characters recall names, preferences and past scenes across weeks, not just within a session.

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.body: A usable free tier of 50 messages a day. Premium removes the cap; Ultra adds priority and image credits.

sections.heading: Privacy
sections.body: Chat deletion works, but the policy doesn't say whether conversations are used for training.

sections.heading: Verdict
sections.body: The best place to start if you want long, coherent roleplay. Pay for Premium only once you hit the daily cap.
